findings.claim: LaTeX accent commands split across lines in a stored abstract can hide a shared passage, violating AC4's normalization requirement.
findings.evidence: Static trace, not executed: use manuscript text 'The café study maps roughness of lunar terrain at metre baselines for rovers.' and the identical abstract with café spelled as caf\' followed by a newline and e. The manuscript produces 13 tokens including cafe. Abstract normalization calls fold_latex(), whose ACCENT pattern accepts only [ \t]* before the letter, so the abstract instead produces caf and e as separate tokens. The longest remaining shared suffix is only 11 tokens, so shared_runs reports nothing. The existing accent test at test_overlap_check.py:241 only puts LaTeX accents on the manuscript side. Fold supported multiline accent spellings consistently on the abstract side and add a regression for this direction.
